correctness.rationale: For m-element involutive Kleene chain, binary meet preservation is exactly monotonicity; (Pos) forces f(floor(m/2))>=floor(m/2), and (Con) implies a sharp disjoint low/high profile for f(0..floor((m-1)/2)). In low profile every value is <=s, in high profile all are constant c>s. Stars-and-bars and hockey-stick yield four stated parity-sensitive formulas, with top-preserving counts by fixing f(m-1)=m-1; m=1 checked separately. Independent exhaustive enumeration of nondecreasing maps for m<=9 agrees with both formulas; no extrapolation from checks.
